TUSD is reconfiguring schools to create a stronger, more sustainable future. We need to use our resources where they have the greatest impact — students, teachers, and classrooms. By acting now, we can ensure every student has access to the opportunities they deserve.
Joint Committee Meeting Sept. 11, 2026
The committee worked with the administration to plan and finalize the goals and outcomes for the community working sessions scheduled for September 21st, September 23rd, and September 26th.


Next Meeting October 1, 2026
 
Joint Committee Meeting Aug 29, 2026
Meeting Summary:
The committee met on Saturday 8-29 from 9AM to 4PM to review crucial data around enrollment trends for TUSD and Pima County, school by school enrollment and budget data, and school by school space utilization and facilities data.  The committee worked to develop possible scenarios for school re-configuration, consolidation, and school closure models.
